steps.content:
January 9, N.F. 114
DisSea Outskirts, 
Third Broken Frontline Monitoring Station,
1.53km from the BR-000 border.
The wasteland is empty, no enemies or ambushes. In the suffocating silence, you can only hear the heavy breaths and footfalls of the guards.

In your head, however, a chaotic voice is mumbling, inciting fear and bewitching your thoughts. Don't listen to it, you think to yourself, for they are just Mania radiating from BR-000. The Mania concentration has been increasing recently, and you know why...
...The <color=#fb9259>Illusory Moon</color> is about to rise, and a new tidal cycle in the DisSea is approaching. In three days, all values are expected to reach the danger zone.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: After the return of Chief, we received more timely warnings from the shackles, allowing us to investigate the anomalies before the outbreak of the Illusory Moon and prepare for the third wave of impact.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: But don't let your guard down. Prioritize protecting Chief ${PlayerName} in this mission. We cannot afford any mishaps. If an emergency occurs, terminate the operation and return to the safe zone at once. Do you understand?

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Yes, sir!
The soldiers respond in unison, their voices loud and resolute. Since they're guarding by your side, their deafening reply makes your heart skip a beat. You almost drop the report in your hand.

options: Thank you, do take care of yourselves, too.

steps.content: The active period of BR-000 has an uncontrollable effect on Sinners, so you've switched your "bodyguards" to reliable FAC soldiers and...

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: You have reached the center of this tidal anomaly. Although the value hasn't reached its peak yet, there are already signs of <color=#fb9259>temporal storms</color>. When the value reaches its peak, the following extreme phenomena might happen:

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Entities within the distortion field may experience temporal superposition and observation indeterminacy. Each observation may yield random results of any time state present within the distortion field.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: This is just a theory based on my calculation. In reality, no one has ever recorded such phenomena. The effect of the storm is beyond our current knowledge and is deemed extremely dangerous.
I didn't quite understand you. But if it's some kind of temporal disorder, can you travel through time and meet people in the past, like in those sci-fi movies? That sounds pretty cool.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: I can't understand you either, but the danger of this operation far exceeds the temporal distortion phenomena you've encountered in the Black Rings before. Please be on your guard at all times.
You chuckle. Well, can't exactly expect this thing to have a sense of humor.
You look up at something not far away...

It's a behemoth armor shrouded in shadow, covered with rust and scratches. Under the red glow of the DisSea tide, it's emanating intense pollution, so threatening that one simply can't stare at it for too long.

You can't tell what kind of machinery this is, what it's made out of, who made it, or why it exists. The only thing that you can be certain of is that: it doesn't belong to this era. It's like a steel colossus that has been dead for centuries, lifeless and decaying.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: 9 hours ago, the monitoring station confirmed that it crossed the BR-000 border and reached the outskirts of the DisSea. Its pollution level well exceeded S-Class, and all timekeeping equipment close to it malfunctioned.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: This is a high-risk object born in the DisSea, and the distortion it brings is rapidly increasing. We probably haven't discovered its real danger yet.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Chief, please don't get any closer. You shouldn't be in such a dangerous area in the first place. There's no need for you to take such a risk no matter what your reason might be.
I told you before. And at that time, the <color=#fb9259>big shot</color> behind you agreed as well.

steps.speaker: EDGE-01
steps.content: I heard you applied for high-level access to the FAC and the 9th Agency for the <color=#fb9259>files on the Black Ring Expedition</color> and <color=#fb9259>classified data from a hundred years ago</color>... I'm afraid you won't hear any good news from them.

steps.speaker: EDGE-01
steps.content: It's nothing personal. Those incomplete records are in disarray and mostly unverified. If fallen into the wrong hands, they could endanger the very core of the city. Even your superiors don't have access to them.

options: But I already know a lot of things, through other means.

steps.content: You stare at the cold black Schorl, recounting the vague yet clear "memories" that you've been replaying in your head and dare not forget since you woke up.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: In N.F. 21, the <color=#fb9259>DisSea Expedition</color> entered the Perishing Star restricted area. Except for Keylan, the hero who brought back the Hypercube, the other <color=#fb9259>42 people</color>, including core researchers and assistants, never left the DisSea.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Dreya the astronomer, and Man... Marguerite Nash the naturalist... I don't have access to those records, but I know these names.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There might also be Banyan the physician, a certain mechanic, and...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: An unknown <color=#fb9259>child guide</color>.
A long silence on the other end... It's so long that you think you've crossed a line and are about to be warned, but then you hear response from it.

steps.speaker: EDGE-01
steps.content: Well then, tell me what you want.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I won't ask for high-level access anymore, I'm fine with what you would give to an FAC combatant; after all, I'm also part of the "Anti-Mania force." During my operation, I'll report to you any extra info I get. In exchange...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know there's been some abnormal activity in the DisSea recently, and the Broken Frontline is strengthening its defenses. If this has anything to do with the <color=#fb9259>periodic activities of the Illusory Moon</color>...

options: I want to be <color=#fb9259>there</color> to take part in the operation.

steps.speaker: EDGE-01
steps.content: Alright, but there's one condition.
It surprises you with a prompt response.

steps.speaker: EDGE-01
steps.content: During the Illusory Moon's tidal period, Mania activities are more frequent than ever. Accidents might happen if you approach the DisSea. Therefore, the investigation must be completed before the Illusory Moon rises. Once the values reach the danger zone, you must stop the operation and return immediately.

steps.speaker: EDGE-01
steps.content: BR-000 is an entirely different thing from Secondary Black Rings. Your emotional responsivity is high, thus I don't know how you will be affected. If you want to get closer to the truth, you can't let your emotions cloud your judgment.

steps.speaker: EDGE-01
steps.content: I need you to return in one piece, physically and mentally.
You express gratitude for this unemotional concern.
I'll be back safely, and bring back some... things that are very important to me.

FAC is busy recording and collecting data on the scene, and some are keeping an eye on the contamination source. Apparently, due to something called "temporal superposition and observation indeterminacy in the temporal storm," if no one is watching this mechanical behemoth, it could jump to "another time state," or even disappear.

Sounds quite mischievous. But you have confirmed multiple times that this thing doesn't have any "driver," or remote control signal. This contamination source is a mere "machine" without any individual will. That's somewhat disappointing to you.
You thought, just like before, you would meet a Sinner, a deeply contaminated creature, or a nostalgic person.

steps.speaker: Calm Voice
steps.content: The truth... is right ahead... above the Illusory Moon, in the depths of the starry sky...
That's the voice of the astronomer you first met, calm just like her eyes looking at the starry sky.

steps.speaker: Persistent Voice
steps.content: Grouping up is truly humanity's most wonderful attribute. Even though I'm just an ordinary person, with them, I can keep going no matter how dark the night. With them, I am invincible.
A friend as warm as sunlight, an insect-loving naturalist, and your brief yet eternal companion.

Those memories were the occasional respites during your 8-month coma filled with nightmares. You constantly think of them, fearing that they are just fleeting illusions that you might forget again. It was such a big relief when you found something in the FAC's DisSea operation records that are remotely connected to those people.
But that's far from enough. You are awake now; you want confirmation; you want to find more of them... The Illusory Moon is rising again. Who will you meet this time?

Deep in your thoughts, a vague human figure appears in front of you. She stands next to the corroded, polluted mech. Even though her face is blurry, you sense that she's looking at you, without hostility.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: ...That earring...

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: ...It's you... Why are you here...

options: I came, but who are you?

steps.content: As the question leaves your lips, you suddenly realize:
You don't know this person. This is not in your memories at all!
Something has invaded your mind, peeping and imitating your emotions, planting things you don't know at all! When did it start? How long has this been going?!
Who are you?! What... are you?!

In response to you is a burst of dazzling red light that almost knocks you out. And then, a large shadow seizes all your senses. As if it suddenly came to life, the monster reveals its terrifying true face.

steps.speaker: Roaring Mech
steps.content: Bzzzzzzz...

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: The contamination source has moved. Retreat! Protect Chief, get him out of here!
steps.female_content: The contamination source has moved. Retreat! Protect Chief, get her out of here!

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: But Chief has passed out!!!

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: What? When did that... No, now is not the time for that. Activate the shield and block the enemy. Get him out of here, quick!
steps.female_content: What? When did that... No, now is not the time for that. Activate the shield and block the enemy. Get her out of here, quick!

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Captain, look up!

Even the most advanced instruments failed to alert the squad beforehand. The Illusory Moon is suddenly up in the sky, as if it had always been there, still rising and expanding. There are no Corruptors, nor attacks, but due to ${PlayerName}'s fall, the red moon instantly instills fear in everyone.
Its increasingly brilliant yet viscous radiance falls upon the ground, like it's about to swallow everything it illuminates.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Review completed. No miscalculations or operation errors detected, but the Illusory Moon rose 72 hours ahead of schedule.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The possible reason for all this could only be...
Separated from your body and the crowded reality, your mind finally stabilizes from the initial impact. You gradually return to your senses amid the chaotic whispers.
...Time... is an illusion... and a cage...
...Give up, let go, stop clinging to your insignificance... Come face the grandeur, become one with eternity...
...Come, find where you... truly belong...
Compared to last time, the moon seems to have changed a bit: it's now split into three parts; it has grown larger, and become... even more talkative. Its voice is buzzing incessantly in your head.

options: Shut up, I'm not here for you.

steps.content: You look at what's in front of you instead. Even without looking at the Illusory Moon, its light still stings your eyes. The immense pressure crashes you down, but you don't feel panic or wish to submit... On the contrary, you're excited.

Right before your eyes, you see everything rapidly decaying and rebuilding. Time grinds everything to dust like a massive vortex and then brings them back to life. It's too fast for human eyes to keep up. At the center of the vortex is that massive, daunting mechanical leviathan. In its shadow, you see a tiny human figure.
It's a familiar yet strange feeling, a call from someone you've never met but long to reunite—the reason why you came here.
What a relief... I thought this would be a fruitless journey, and those were just my dreams.

It's lucky that I caught the Illusory Moon this time and got to participate in this operation... It's lucky that I <color=#fb9259>came</color> here, went through some sort of temporal storm and met you.
Summoning the shackles, you take a step forward.

options: I'll take you back, let's go back together!
